diagnosticPolicy: Repeated diagnosis also requires AS-DC-001; passing input/log/control checks alone does not justify another whole-input observation.
description: Before a high-cost gate, every changed contract must have a harness-declared downstream consumer inventory, exact passing audits, positive and negative cheap probes, stable active inputs, and durable outcome observability.
lateFailurePolicy: every prior late expensive failure is promoted to a passing cheaper probe before rerunning the expensive gate
outcomeObservabilityPolicy: before launch, reserve distinct durable log and structured completion record paths; use a detached supervisor that survives observer disconnect, waits only for the supervised process rather than an inherited-handle process tree, and guarantees a completion record on termination; the record must preserve exit code and exact failure identifiers, require zero failure identifiers on success, and derive failure identifiers only from failure context
